blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — Hog raisers in Medellin, Cebu, will have a municipal reference buying price of P190 per kilogram of pork carcass, while pork belly will carry a recommended minimum selling price of P240 per kilogram. This is under a new executive order aimed at protecting local producers and guiding consumers. Mayor Edwin Salimbangon issued an executive order earlier this week establishing the reference prices and directing local authorities to strengthen meat inspection, monitor market prices, and verify the origin of hogs supplied to the municipality.
